subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository authorize these exact third-party action revisions for workflows that receive app private keys, repository/registry tokens, and an OpenAI API key after a current-head representative workflow run?
rationale: The mechanical version bumps alter executable third-party code inside credential-bearing CI and release paths; maintainer trust ownership cannot be inferred from Dependabot metadata or ordinary static CI.

options.title: Approve after trust and live validation
options.body: Verify each revised pinned commit against its upstream release and attach redacted current-head output from at least one representative secret-bearing workflow before merging.

options.title: Hold the update
options.body: Keep this PR open until a workflow/security owner is prepared to accept the third-party action revisions and their credential-bound execution risk.

recommendation.title: Approve after trust and live validation
recommendation.body: Verify each revised pinned commit against its upstream release and attach redacted current-head output from at least one representative secret-bearing workflow before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR timeline shows direct involvement, but code-history ownership could not be established from the available read-only environment.
